summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The NYLIM Candriam International Equity ETF (IQSI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a proprietary index of developed-market stocks selected by ESG criteria and weighted by market-cap. IQSI was launched on Dec 17, 2019 and is issued by NYLIM.
infoTable: IQ Candriam ESG International Equity Index

holdings.infoBox: IQSI is an equity ETF with a total of 609 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 4.82%, Roche Holding AG at 2.12%, AstraZeneca at 1.75%, Nestlé at 1.74%, and Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 1.61%.
